## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `060842a240de85253916837cf247d813f9910406`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Cards #34648 and #34268, one PR. Inputs: both cards with every comment, the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main`, the check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read in the PR tree to judge the two bullets, never reviewed: `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/serverActionHandler.ts`. The changeset is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: no change. No schema, validator or runtime file is in the diff; nothing an author writes is newly accepted or refused. Right.
- Public surface, `@objectstack/skills`: `rules/actions.md` gains two bullets and loses 28 bytes of the `preflight` bullet; the eval fixture gains cases 22 and 23. Additive teaching of capabilities already on `main` (`resultDialog` and its `table` format; `BulkActionResultSchema` and its grid reader). Right.
- Gate constant: the `rules/actions.md` ceiling row moves 3333 to 3711 in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; one row, no logic change. Right (arithmetic under ④).
- Check-runs on the head: every completed run is `success` or `skipped`, none failed. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and both `PR-body guards` runs are `success`. `Queue verdict` is `skipped`.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` matches what the diff publishes: skill prose and eval cases, no code and no accept-set move. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand on both the PR body and the changeset and agree with the diff; `Check Changeset` is `success`. The ratchet script is not published. Correct level.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, `input.selectedIds` on the `list_toolbar` row (line 27), in the Add to Campaign example (line 110) and in eval 1's `must_contain`: answered. Those lines are outside this diff and are not reviewed here. The new bullet's `input._selectedIds` is the spelling the tree holds (`ACTION_PARAM_BUILTIN_KEYS`, the showcase `predicate-matrix.action.ts` body), so the diff is right and the older lines are the ones in doubt; after this PR the file carries both spellings. ESCALATED to the seat as a follow-up card on `domain:skills`; not a condition of this PR.
- Dev flag, the evals README one-line summary left as is: accepted; not a `hits` file and not in the diff.
- Dev flag, "the cases were not run against a model in this PR": ESCALATED. Card #34648's Done-when reads "the rule teaches it and the eval passes", and the PR closes the card with the second half unmeasured. No check-run on the head runs the eval. The seat decides whether a run is owed before close or the card's clause is waived; this record judges the cases as written (④) and cannot stand in for a run.
- Budget: the claim on #34648 (7013685431) sets a net-added-line budget of 40 with "stop on breach; explain in the report"; the diff is 45 added, 2 deleted, net 43, and the PR body measures it against "the order's 45". The dispatch order is not an input of this review, so the 45 is unverified here. ESCALATED to the seat to confirm the figure; `Check PR Size` is `success`.
- File surface: the same claim lists `rules/actions.md`, `evals/**` and the changeset; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is a fourth file. It is the one ceiling row the text change forces and the PR body names it for the maintainer. Answered: accepted as the gate edit the change requires, under the ruling its note cites (the same ruling and wording the 3180 to 3333 note on `main` already rests on); the ruling record itself is not among this review's inputs.
- Card #34648 comment 6941854066 (no per-cell copy for `text` / `code-list`, `secret` / `qrcode` keep theirs): answered in the bullet's last sentence, see ④.
- Triage note on #34648 (teach the merged describe, not the draft sentence): answered, see ④.
- `Security-touching: yes` is meant, on a narrow basis: the new bullet teaches how a `secret` value is offered to the reader in a result dialog (the copy control a `secret` cell keeps), and the rewritten `preflight` line is the one carrying "no body or credentials" and "UX, not authorization". No permission, sharing or authentication rule is added or changed.
- SQL push-down: not applicable; no query, id materialisation or join in the diff.
- `open_questions`: none on either card or in the PR body beyond the flags above.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, `resultDialog` bullet, sentence by sentence against `action.zod.ts` and `ActionResultDialog.tsx`:
- "in place of the success toast (so no `successMessage`; `outcomeMessages` is refused beside it)": the key's describe says it suppresses `successMessage`; `refuseInertOutcomeMessages` refuses `outcomeMessages` beside it. Holds.
- Keys `title`, `description`, `acknowledge`, `format`, `fields`: the strict object's exact key set. Holds.
- Field row `path`, `label`, `format`, and the six formats: `actionAnswerFieldRow` and `ACTION_ANSWER_FIELD_FORMATS`. Holds.
- `table` with `columns` of `path`, `label`, `format`; one row per element, one cell per column; required with `table`, refused beside any other format: `ActionAnswerTableColumnSchema` and `refuseTableColumnContradictions` (which also refuses an empty list and `columns` with no format). Holds.
- Dialog-level `format` defaults to `json`, a cell's to `text`, neither takes `table`: `actionAnswerScalarFormat` on both slots; `column.format ?? 'text'` in the renderer. Holds.
- Copy sentence: `TableCellValue` draws `text` as a bare span and `code-list` as a bare list, and hands `secret` and `qrcode` to the blocks that carry `CopyButton`. Holds, and it is scoped to a cell, which is what comment 6941854066 asked for; a top-level `text` field does keep its copy button and the bullet does not say otherwise.
- The sentence is the merged describe, not the card's draft: it adds the toast and `outcomeMessages` rules, the key list, the two defaults and the copy rule.

Aggregate bullet against `bulk-action.zod.ts`, `useBulkExecutor.ts` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`:
- One call, ids in `params._selectedIds`: `runBulkActionAggregate`. Holds.
- Resolves `succeeded` as a string list and `failed` as `id` plus `message`, as the whole return value: `BulkActionResultSchema`; `readActionPayload(res.data)` hands the reader the handler's own value. `BulkActionResult` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. Holds.
- A throw is one outcome for the selection: the `catch` arm sets `aggregateRejection`. Holds.
- Outside id dropped, duplicate once, both lists counts as failed, neither is not confirmed: `readAggregateResult`, line for line. Holds.
- Neither member keeps the whole-selection report; either member that does not parse is unreadable: `carriesMember` then `safeParse`. Both lists are required by the schema, so "(counts, one list)" is accurate. Holds.
- All five points of card #34268 are taught.

Tried to break it: a handler returning only `failed` (unreadable, as taught); an id in both lists (failed, as taught); `columns` on a field with no format (refused, covered by "refused beside any other format"); `table` at dialog level (refused, as taught). None breaks the text.

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`:
- Case 22: the expected output parses under the schema (field-level `table`, object columns). `display: 'table'` is a real refused alias and `columns: ['email'` a real wrong shape; neither is a string a correct answer needs. Holds against card #34648's eval ask.
- Case 23: the expected output is a legal `BulkActionResult`; `succeeded: ids.length` is the count shape the schema refuses. "Not a `resultDialog`" is consistent with the grid: the per-row report is the bulk dialog's. Holds.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file): the cut string is 28 bytes; 13330 + 1541 - 28 = 14843, the size of the file at the head; ceil(14843 / 4) = 3711; ceiling +378, zero headroom, pinned at the measurement. The note agrees with the tree. The cut loses nothing: the row shape now sits one bullet below.

Nits, none affecting correctness or the contract:
- N1 (nit) — `resultDialog` bullet: "(omitted: the whole answer as JSON)" follows the gloss of `path`, though it is `fields` that may be omitted (`path` is required). The key list marks `fields` optional and `path` not, so the reading is recoverable.
- N2 (nit) — case 22's expected output puts `format: 'text'` on `imported`, a number. `valueFitsFormat` takes a string for `text`, so the renderer draws that field as `json`. The count still shows; dropping the `format` from the expected output would be exact.
- N3 (nit) — `preflight` bullet after the cut reads "`fields` rows are `resultDialog.fields`' (omitted: JSON)", a possessive with no noun. The spec's own phrase is "row and format set".
- N4 (nit) — case 22's `must_contain` pins `format: 'table'` with single quotes; a correct answer in double quotes misses. This is the fixture's standing convention (`type: 'record'`, `type: 'wizard'`), so left as is.
